examples.label: Mobile bottom navigation pinned to the viewport
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-dock" site="Global" id="dock-mobile-app-bar" position="fixed_bottom" variant="shadow" color="natural">
  <:item icon="hero-home" label="Home" navigate="/" active />
  <:item icon="hero-magnifying-glass" label="Search" navigate="/search" />
  <:item icon="hero-bell" label="Alerts" navigate="/notifications" badge="4" />
  <:item icon="hero-user" label="Account" navigate="/account" />
</.component>

examples.label: Floating pill dock over a photo gallery
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-dock" site="Global" id="dock-gallery-pill" position="fixed_bottom_center" variant="bordered" color="dark" rounded="full" padding="small" space="medium" size="large" show_labels={false}>
  <:item icon="hero-photo" navigate="/gallery" active />
  <:item icon="hero-heart" navigate="/gallery/favourites" />
  <:item icon="hero-arrow-down-tray" navigate="/gallery/downloads" />
  <:item icon="hero-adjustments-horizontal" navigate="/gallery/settings" />
</.component>

examples.label: Storefront bottom bar with a cart badge
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-dock" site="Global" id="dock-store-nav" position="sticky_bottom" variant="bordered" color="primary" rounded="large">
  <:item icon="hero-squares-2x2" label="Shop" navigate="/shop" />
  <:item icon="hero-bookmark" label="Saved" navigate="/saved" />
  <:item icon="hero-shopping-bag" label="Cart" navigate="/cart" badge="2" active />
  <:item icon="hero-user-circle" label="Profile" navigate="/profile" />
</.component>

examples.label: Documentation section switcher docked to the top
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-dock" site="Global" id="dock-docs-sections" position="sticky_top" max_width="large" space="large" padding="small">
  <:item icon="hero-newspaper" label="Guides" navigate="/docs/guides" active />
  <:item icon="hero-code-bracket" label="API reference" navigate="/docs/api" />
  <:item icon="hero-adjustments-horizontal" label="Recipes" navigate="/docs/recipes" />
  <:item icon="hero-clock" label="Changelog" navigate="/docs/changelog" />
</.component>
